Package org.apache.juneau.config.internal

Record Class ConfigMapEntry

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.apache.juneau.config.internal.ConfigMapEntry
Record Components:
rawLine - The raw line this entry was parsed from, or null if the entry was created programmatically.
key - The name of this entry.
value - The raw value of this entry.
comment - The same-line comment of this entry, or null if it has no comment.
modifiers - The modifiers for this entry, or null if it has no modifiers.
preLines - The pre-lines of this entry as an unmodifiable list.
public record ConfigMapEntry(String rawLine, String key, String value, String comment, String modifiers, List<String> preLines) extends Record
Represents a single entry in a configuration. This is a read-only object.

    • ConfigMapEntry

      public ConfigMapEntry(String rawLine, String key, String value, String comment, String modifiers, List<String> preLines)
      Canonical constructor.

      Normalizes preLines to an unmodifiable copy (empty when null) so this record is truly immutable.
